title: ESPAI Synthetic EPIC-MOS1 Camera Solar-Flare events (Version 1.0)

citation.text: ESPAI Project (2025). ESPAI Solar Flare — Synthetic Solar Flare Dataset, v1.0. Koexai. URL: https://ESPAI.koexai.com/resources/  Licence: CC BY 4.0.

abstract: This dataset contains 248,963 synthetic solar-flare events generated using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) approach. The data simulates the distribution of events on an X-ray telescope (namely XMM-Newton MOS1 camera), characterized by spatial coordinates and energy channels. Each row represents a single photon event with detector coordinates (DETX, DETY) and Pulse Invariant (PI) energy values. These distributions are suitable for background modeling or testing machine learning algorithms in high-energy astrophysics.
purpose: Generate realistic synthetic solar-flare events for training machine learning models or background modeling.

provenance.sources: Generated via Variational Autoencoder (VAE) trained on observational data.
provenance.processing: 1) VAE model training with ELBO loss (combining Reconstruction, KS, and KL divergence), 2) Latent space sampling via reparameterisation trick.
provenance.derivations: Synthetic event list containing DETX, DETY, and PI columns.

structure.conventions: Columns: DETX (Detector X coordinate), DETY (Detector Y coordinate), PI (Pulse Invariant energy channel). DETX range: ~-16968 to 17239. DETY range: ~-17356 to 16940. PI range: ~300 to 11999.
structure.relationships: Single table with 248,963 rows (events) and 4 columns (including index).

quality.usageGuidance: Suitable for statistical studies of detector distribution or ML training.

access.reuseGuidance: Suitable for academic research and machine learning applications
